Select compounds tested against human P2X7 purinoceptor (CHEMBL4805) with IC50 activities in nM. Require compounds to have a canonical SMILES string and activities to have a PubMed ID or DOI. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Use the join path molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce the SMILES requirement. Filter by target CHEMBL4805 and standard_type IC50. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Do not sort.
